name: testate
description: Git for your test database. Reset the database, not the developer.
author: PT. Perkasa Pilar Utama

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:api
scripts.type-check: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: oxlint apps packages scripts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix apps packages scripts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.complete-check: bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run fmt && bun test && bun run build
